name: Tubbs Fire
note: Started around 9:43 pm on Sunday 8 Oct 2017 near Tubbs Lane, Calistoga; by 1 am on Monday 9 Oct it had reached the Santa Rosa city limits, and Fountaingrove, Coffey Park (about 1,300 structures), Larkfield-Wikiup and Mark West burned in the early hours.

name: Nuns Fire
note: Began about 10 pm on 8 Oct 2017 on Nuns Canyon Rd; Glen Ellen, Kenwood and Bennett Valley burned overnight and on 9 Oct (it later merged with the Adobe, Norrbom, Pressley, Partrick and Oakmont fires).

name: Atlas Fire
note: Reported 9:52 pm on 8 Oct 2017 off Atlas Peak Rd; Soda Canyon, Atlas Peak and Silverado burned overnight into 9 Oct.

name: Kincade Fire
note: Started 9:24 pm on 23 Oct 2019 at The Geysers; most of the 374 structures CAL FIRE inspected as destroyed were lost in the wind event of 27 Oct, when the fire ran through Alexander Valley and Chalk Hill toward Windsor.

name: LNU Lightning Complex (Hennessey Fire)
note: Lightning fires of 17 Aug 2020 merged; on the night of 18-19 Aug the fire ran through Berryessa Highlands, Spanish Flat and the Pleasants Valley / English Hills area west of Vacaville.

name: LNU Lightning Complex (Walbridge Fire)
note: Lightning fire of 17 Aug 2020 west of Healdsburg; homes on Mill Creek Rd and above Guerneville / Rio Nido (Austin Creek, Armstrong Woods) were lost 18-20 Aug.

name: CZU Lightning Complex
note: Lightning fires of 16 Aug 2020 merged in the wind shift of the evening of 18 Aug and burned Boulder Creek's outskirts, Big Basin, Bonny Doon, Swanton and Last Chance 18-20 Aug.

name: Glass Fire
note: Started 3:48 am on 27 Sep 2020 near Deer Park; with the Shady and Boysen spot fires it burned Deer Park, the hills around St. Helena and Calistoga and the Skyhawk / Los Alamos Rd edge of Santa Rosa on 27-28 Sep.

name: Oakland Hills (Tunnel) Fire
note: Rekindled about 10:45 am on Sunday 20 Oct 1991 above the Caldecott Tunnel; nearly all of the 2,843 houses and 437 apartment units were lost that day.

name: Hanly Fire
note: Burned 52,700 acres (FRAP outline: 55,961 GIS acres) from Calistoga to Mendocino Avenue on the north edge of Santa Rosa, turning on its third day; only a few dozen homes burned, the country being sparsely settled in 1964. The Tubbs Fire followed its path in 2017. FRAP alarm date (19 Sep 1964) kept.

name: SCU Lightning Complex
note: Lightning fires of 16-18 Aug 2020 in the Diablo Range (Santa Clara, Alameda, Contra Costa, San Joaquin, Stanislaus counties); FRAP alarm date kept.

name: Lexington Fire
note: FRAP perimeter 'LEXINGTON' 1985: alarm date 7 Jul 1985, 13,128 GIS acres in the Santa Cruz Mountains above Lexington Reservoir. Alarm date kept; no structure data.

name: Mount Vision Fire
note: Started 3 Oct 1995 from an illegal campfire on Mount Vision, Point Reyes: 12,354 acres and 45 homes on Inverness Ridge. FRAP alarm date kept.
